subject: microbiology
title: Primary immunodeficiency and transplant rejection

steps.tx: **Antibody deficiencies** announce after maternal IgG wanes at 6 months with recurrent sinopulmonary bacterial infections: **X linked agammaglobulinaemia** (Bruton tyrosine kinase, absent B cells with all isotypes low, live vaccines avoided, **IVIG** lifelong), **common variable immunodeficiency** (adults, low IgG with low IgA or IgM, autoimmunity with granulomas and bronchiectasis), selective **IgA deficiency** (commonest, mostly silent, anaphylaxis to blood products with anti IgA), and hyper IgM (CD40L, opportunists with neutropenia). Isohaemagglutinins absent flag functionally.
steps.say: Six month old with bacterial pneumonias and no B cells is Bruton: IVIG for life. Adult low IgG with autoimmunity is CVID.

steps.tx: **Combined and cellular defects** threaten earlier and wider: **SCID** (T low with variable B, ADA or cytokine chain defects, newborn **TREC screening**, BMT or gene therapy before live vaccines kill), **DiGeorge** (22q11, thymic aplasia with **hypocalcaemia**, conotruncal hearts, irradiated blood only), **Wiskott-Aldrich** (X linked, eczema with **thrombocytopenia of small platelets** and infections), **Job syndrome** (STAT3, high IgE with retained primary teeth and cold abscesses). **Chronic granulomatous disease** (NADPH oxidase, **DHR test**, catalase positive Aspergillus and Staph) and **leukocyte adhesion deficiency** (CD18, delayed cord separation) break phagocytes.
steps.say: Absent thymic shadow with low calcium is DiGeorge: irradiate blood. Small platelets plus eczema is Wiskott-Aldrich.

steps.tx: **Transplant rejection** times itself: **hyperacute** (preformed ABO or anti HLA DSA, minutes, fibrinoid necrosis with thrombosis, never treat, remove), **acute cellular** (T cells, weeks to months, tubulitis with endotheliitis, pulse steroids or ATG), **acute humoral** (DSA with C4d staining, plasmapheresis with IVIG and rituximab), **chronic** (months to years, graft vasculopathy with interstitial fibrosis, untreatable, re transplant listed). Prevention is ABO compatibility, **HLA matching** (DR matters most), **complement dependent crossmatch** with flow, and panel reactive antibody minimised by desensitisation.
steps.say: Minutes blue graft is hyperacute: preformed antibody, remove. Tubulitis weeks later is cellular: pulse steroids.

steps.tx: **Graft versus host disease** reverses direction (graft attacking host) after BMT or transfusion in immunodeficiency: acute (within 100 days, skin rash with **GI diarrhoea and liver cholestasis**) versus chronic (sicca, scleroderma, bronchiolitis obliterans). Irradiated blood products prevent transfusion associated GVHD. Maintenance uses **calcineurin inhibitors** (ciclosporin, tacrolimus: nephrotoxic with tremor and diabetes), **mycophenolate or azathioprine**, **mTOR sirolimus**, steroids and basiliximab induction; levels monitored as infection and **PTLD** (EBV driven) stalk over suppression.
steps.say: Rash plus diarrhoea plus cholestasis post BMT is acute GVHD. Irradiate blood for immunodeficients.
